import pandas as pd

# Load the datasets
pollen_df = pd.read_csv('/data/pollen_openness_score_Belau_Woserin_Feeser_et_al_2019.csv')
time_series_df = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')
capital_df = pd.read_csv('/data/capital.csv')

# Display the first few rows of each dataset to understand their structure
pollen_df.head(), time_series_df.head(), capital_df.head()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Plot the Z values for Daggers from the time_series_data.csv dataset
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.plot(time_series_df['CE'], time_series_df['Dagger'], label='Dagger Z values (time_series_data)')
plt.xlabel('CE')
plt.ylabel('Z values')
plt.title('Z values for Daggers over Time (time_series_data)')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

# Plot the Z values for Daggers from the capital.csv dataset
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.plot(capital_df['BCE'], capital_df['ZDolch'], label='Dagger Z values (capital)')
plt.xlabel('BCE')
plt.ylabel('Z values')
plt.title('Z values for Daggers over Time (capital)')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

# Analyze the time_series_data.csv dataset for the first significant increase in Dagger Z values
time_series_dagger = time_series_df[['CE', 'Dagger']]
time_series_dagger.head()

# Analyze the capital.csv dataset for the first significant increase in ZDolch Z values
capital_dagger = capital_df[['BCE', 'ZDolch']]
capital_dagger.head()

# Identify the first significant increase in Dagger Z values in time_series_data.csv
time_series_dagger['Dagger'].plot(title='Dagger Z values over Time (time_series_data)')
plt.xlabel('CE')
plt.ylabel('Z values')
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

# Identify the first significant increase in ZDolch Z values in capital.csv
capital_dagger['ZDolch'].plot(title='ZDolch Z values over Time (capital)')
plt.xlabel('BCE')
plt.ylabel('Z values')
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
